description: This file defines the class UrlRegexpTransform, which is a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel used to generate product URLs with optional SEO pattern matching, URL rewriting, and security token handling within the OFBiz framework. It processes URL transformations based on configuration and request context, supporting URL encoding, full path generation, and URL pattern matching for SEO optimization.

classes.name: UrlRegexpTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class providing URL rewriting, SEO URL pattern matching, CSRF token integration, and URL encoding for product links within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes URL transformation and outputs the final URL based on request context and arguments.

methods.name: seoUrl
methods.description: Transforms a URL into an SEO-friendly URL based on configured regex patterns and replacement rules.

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: Performs URL forwarding based on regex pattern matching and sets the appropriate HTTP response status and Location header.
